text:
IncidentBot: [ALERT] High org-level qps for org=brightpath detected in us-west-2 · 80% of org quota consumed in last 2m · auto-throttle engaged
Mia: seeing it on dashboard, brightpath spiked to 1200 qps, their normal is ~100 qps. latency goes up and errors creeping.
Devon: thanks — paging oncall. I'm on-call and looking now. Do we know if this is legitimate traffic or a runaway loop?
Samir: logs show a flood of /v1/generate requests with small prompts, high token churn. user-agent: brightpath-batch/1.2. Looks like a background job.
Mia: they just released a training rollout earlier today, might be ramping. Customer is in enterprise tier with reserved dedicated capacity but not on dedicated for this org (hosted).
Devon: ok, impact: error rate for other customers in same region increasing from 0.2% → 2.5% due to circuit tripping on worker nodes. Need quick mitigation that minimizes customer disruption.
Tina: options: 1) org-level temporary rate limit (hotfix +20% quota) 2) org-level hard cap (block excess) 3) feature disable (e.g., disable streaming for that org) 4) route their traffic to lower-cost model variant. Which to pick?
Mia: prefer temporary increase because blocking will break their job and could cascade. we can pair with backoff advisory to them. Also prepare rollback.
Devon: agree. apply an emergency org quota bump to 2x their current quota for 15 minutes, with auto-revert and alert if token utilization still > 90% at end. I can do the change in the admin UI or via infra API.
Samir: I can run the infra API; share the command.
Devon: use this API call from runbook: 
```
POST https://admin.redwood/api/v1/orgs/brightpath/limits?scope=runtime
Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN
Body: {"qps_limit":2400, "duration_secs":900, "note":"emergency-burst-bump 2468001234"}
```
Devon: running it now.
Devon: response 200. bump applied: org.qps_limit=2400 for 900s. IncidentBot: {alert: mitigation-applied, by: Devon, change_id: ch_8b4f}
Mia: I see the throttles relaxed and worker queue draining. latency stabilizing back to baseline for other orgs. good.
Tina: notify BrightPath support + PMs: "we applied temporary bump due to background job spike; please validate and throttle upstream job; we'll auto-revert in 15m". Who will ping them?
Samir: I'll DM their SRE and cc acct team. Doing now.
Leo: /remind me in 12 minutes to check reversion status and whether we need extension.
Mia: also logging this as an incident ticket: INCIDENT-2468001234. Add summary + mitigation steps and owner.
Devon: note for postmortem: add suggestion for org-side soft-limiter or per-client tokenized keys so a runaway job doesn't hit org quota in one shot. Also evaluate applying adaptive shaping (slow-start) for large bursts.
Samir: Customer replied: "Thanks, we saw the bump — we accidentally re-enabled a batch job. turning it off now. appreciate the quick help."
Mia: good. I'll leave monitoring on. If they go back to normal, we'll let the bump auto-revert. If not, we consider an org hard cap + outreach.
IncidentBot: [SCHEDULED] auto-revert scheduled at 2468002134 · watch_key=ch_8b4f
Tina: prepping handoff: I'm taking second shift in 10m. Devon, if things stable, can you include the rollback verification steps in the handoff?
Devon: yes. Rollback verification steps: 1) check org.qps < 2x baseline 2) check region latency p95 for non-brightpath customers 3) confirm admin API shows change status=expired. Commands: 
```
GET /admin/api/v1/orgs/brightpath/limits
GET /telemetry/regions/us-west-2/latency?p95
```
Leo: reminder fired — seeing auto-revert at 2468002134 in logs. I'm on-watch for reversion.
Mia: after revert metrics look clean: other orgs latency normal and brightpath qps is back to ~90. Closing mitigation window.
Tina: leaving notes for oncall tomorrow and adding a follow-up: contact BrightPath PM to propose safer rollout and maybe quota escrow during testing.
Devon: assigning post-incident owner: Samir. Samir: please create the postmortem and include recommended safer default: auto-slow-start + org burst tokens.
Samir: will do, creating PMT and pinging BrightPath for RCA.
IncidentBot: Incident CLOSED · duration 00:22:07 · mitigations: emergency-org-qps-bump (auto-revert) · owner: Samir
